added: Importing from your calendar now fills each draft program's start and end times from a timed event, and shows them beside the date in the list before you import, where events on the same day are now listed in the order they start. A time your calendar keeps in a time zone is taken as written; a time kept in UTC is turned into your device's local time. An all-day event still gets no times, and the lesson and Arrive by times are never read from an event.

ICalEvent reads DTEND and DURATION, and ICalDateValue.localDateTime gives a value's wall-clock date and time for the reader. CalendarImportCandidate carries startMinute and endMinute, set for each occurrence (a series' length moves with each occurrence; an override keeps its own); the end is left empty for an event of no length, one that ends in its start's own minute, or one of a day or more. A Z event's end is computed as an instant and converted to local time, so it is right across a daylight-saving change. Candidates on one date are sorted by start time.
